import time
import numpy as np
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode, V_INIT_MV
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial
artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
from neuron import h
h.cvode.active(True)
# Boost soma+AIS HH but tweak el_hh to maintain rest at -65 mV.
soma = artifacts.cell.soma
ais = artifacts.cell.axon_initial_segment
soma.gnabar_hh = 0.2
ais.gnabar_hh = 1.0
ais.gkbar_hh = 0.05
ais.el_hh = -45.0  # raise el so cell doesn't go below -65
soma.el_hh = -50.0
print(f'soma gnabar={soma(0.5).hh.gnabar} gkbar={soma(0.5).hh.gkbar} el={soma(0.5).hh.el}')
print(f'ais gnabar={ais(0.5).hh.gnabar} gkbar={ais(0.5).hh.gkbar} el={ais(0.5).hh.el}')

v_rec = h.Vector()
v_rec.record(soma(0.5)._ref_v)
h.finitialize(V_INIT_MV)
h.continuerun(50.0)
v = np.array(list(v_rec))
print('quiescent v_final=', v[-1])

t0 = time.time()
res = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, angle_deg=0.0, trial_seed=1)
print(f'AMPA_ONLY 0: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')

t0 = time.time()
res2 = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, angle_deg=180.0, trial_seed=1)
print(f'AMPA_ONLY 180: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res2.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res2.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')

# Now FULL mode at theta=0 (should fire well; gabaMOD=0.33)
t0 = time.time()
res3 = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=TrialMode.FULL, angle_deg=0.0, trial_seed=1)
print(f'FULL 0: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res3.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res3.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')

# FULL theta=180 (gabaMOD=0.99 - strong inhibition)
t0 = time.time()
res4 = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=TrialMode.FULL, angle_deg=180.0, trial_seed=1)
print(f'FULL 180: t={time.time()-t0:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res4.spike_times_ms)} v_max={res4.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')
